Scenario fixture: iframe-title-unique (frames sharing a title embed the same resource)

Each target has a stable id of the form ifu_case_NN. Compares the title ATTRIBUTE only, not the full computed accessible name. Frames sharing a title form a set; a set passes when every member resolves to one resource and is reported cantTell (never fail) when the resources differ, since differently addressed resources can still be equivalent and nothing in the markup settles it.

A. Unique titles

01 — PASS: unique title among the frames in the accessibility tree

B. Shared titles, one resource

02 — PASS: first frame sharing title "Video player", same src as 03
03 — PASS: second frame sharing title "Video player", same src as 02
04 — PASS: "Contact us" pointing at a directory with a trailing slash
05 — PASS: "Contact us" pointing at the same directory without the slash
06 — PASS: "Help" pointing at a fragment within the resource
07 — PASS: "Help" pointing at the same resource without the fragment

C. Shared titles, different resources

08 — CANTTELL: first "Advert" frame, resource differs from 09 (equivalence-unknown)
09 — CANTTELL: second "Advert" frame, resource differs from 08 (equivalence-unknown)
10 — CANTTELL: "Notes" frame whose partner has no src to compare (equivalence-unknown)
11 — CANTTELL: "Notes" frame with srcdoc and no src, resource unresolved (not-computable)

D. Not applicable (skipped, not counted)

12 — NEUTRAL: frame with no title attribute
13 — NEUTRAL: aria-hidden frame sharing "Chat widget" with 01 is not part of a set

End of fixture.
